data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 25.532 million in 2017, representing a 23.05% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was calculated from the claims development triangle, showing favorable development for the 2014 and 2015 underwriting years. The report also mentions the implementation of an Adverse Development Cover (ADC) contract in 2017, covering casualty claim reserves for underwriting years 2008 to 2015, designed to provide capital relief and reduce volatility from insurance risk. However, the specific causes for the overall favorable development are not explicitly detailed.
